title: BSH Home Appliances Recalls Dishwashers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The power cord can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 149,000 (in addition, about 45,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Outdoor Patio Swivel Armchairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The swivel armchair can tip backward while rocking and consumers can fall off, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 2,500 in the U.S. (in addition, about 30 were sold in Canada).

title: Horizon Hobby Recalls E-flite Chargers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The chargers can overcharge the batteries and overheat, which could result in a fire, property damage and injury. Units: About 1,300.

title: TCC Cooking Company Recalls CHEFS Vertical Roasters Due to Burn and Laceration Hazards
summary: The vertical roasters can break or shatter, posing burn and laceration hazards. Units: About 4,000.

title: Safety 1st Recalls Décor Wood Highchairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: A child can remove the highchair's tray, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 35,000.

title: Bed Handles Inc Reannounces Recall of Adult Portable Bed Handles Following Report of Fourth Entrapment Death
summary: When attached to an adult's bed without the use of safety retention straps, the handle can shift out of place, creating a dangerous gap between the bed handle and the side of the mattress. This poses a serious risk of entrapment, strangulation and death. Units: About 113,000.

title: BRP Recalls Youth All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fuel filter can break and leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 240.

title: Polaris Recalls RZR Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicles' fuel tank vent line can be misrouted, causing it to become pinched. This can cause the fuel tank to pressurize and leak fuel, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 53,000 vehicles.

title: Sportsmans Guide Recalls Guide Gear Ground Pop-up Hunting Blinds Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Blinds are not made of flame-resistant materials, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 17,000.

title: Lighthouse Recalls Ceramic Mugs Due to Burn Hazard
summary: Hot liquids can seep through hairline cracks, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 4,400.

title: Maeli Rose Recalls Girls' Hoodies Due to a Strangulation Hazard
summary: The hoodies have a drawstring inside the lining of the hood that surrounds the face which poses a strangulation hazard to children. title: QBP Recalls WeThePeople BMX Bicycles and Cranksets Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The left end of the bicycle crankset spindle can break, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 70 bicycles and about 170 cranksets (in addition, about 40 bicycles and about 40 cranksets were sold in Canada).

title: Sure Signal Products Recalls Heat-Activated Fire Alarms Due to Failure to Alert Consumers of a Fire
summary: A defective fusible link sensor (fuse) on the fire alarm can cause the alarm to fail to alert consumers of a fire. Units: About 375,000.

title: Burley Design Recalls Child Bicycle Trailers Due to Injury Risk
summary: Trailers with black plastic tow bar receivers can separate from the tow bar when they appear to be connected, posing a crash hazard to the child in the trailer. Units: About 34,000 (in addition about 820 were sold in Canada).

title: Pottery Barn Kids Recalls Avengers and Darth Vader Water Bottles Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The gray paint on the metal portion of the water bottle can contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 15,200 (in addition, 430 units were sold in Canada).

title: LaRose Industries Recalls Peanuts Flying Ace Ride-On Toys Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: The toy's blue hubcaps can detach from the wheel's axle, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 11,000.

title: Build-A-Bear Recalls Stuffed Animals Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The satin seam of the stuffed animal can open, allowing the stuffing material to be exposed, posing a choking hazard for young children. Units: About 33,600 (an additional 1,000 were sold in Canada).

title: L.L. Bean Recalls Knives with Sheath Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The knife can cut through the sheath, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 300.

title: United States Stove Company Recalls Pellet Stoves Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The internal fire box baffle can degrade, overheat and pose a fire hazard. Units: About 4,400.

title: Innopower Recalls Hawk Climbing Sticks Due to Fall Hazard
summary: Folding steps can bend or break during use, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 730.

title: Krud Kutter Recalls Adhesive Removers Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure and Cautionary Labeling Requirements
summary: The packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act and the labeling on the product violates the Federal Hazardous Substances Act because it does not warn of the hazard presented. title: Liquid Force Recalls Response Kiteboard Control Systems Due to Risk of Injury (Recall Alert)
summary: The chicken loop release system, which is used to depower the kite, can stick and fail to open, posing a risk of injury to the kiteboarder. Units: About 2,050 (in addition, about 40 were sold in Canada).

title: Big Game Recalls Tree Stands Due to Fall
summary: The cable assembly on the climbing tree stand can release, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 12,200.

title: Global Manufacturing Company Recalls API Outdoors Tree Stands Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The cable assembly on the climbing tree stand can release, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 5,300.

title: Golden Horse Recalls Children's Denim Pants Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Belk Stores
summary: The zipper pull can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 8,300.

title: XO FOUR Stealth Gaming Headsets Recalled By Turtle Beach Due to Risk of Exposure to Mold
summary: Mold spores were found on the headsets, posing a risk of respiratory or other infections in individuals with chronic health problems. Units: About 59,500.
